    time.sleep(3)
    try:

    except ProcessLookupError:
        pass
    print("stopped", flush=True)

content.text:
**My proposal is to keep OrcaSlicer's empty project in memory rather than remove it, and I've built that part: a blank project now stays in memory until it holds something of yours.** Removing it entirely isn't practical. The fix also covers the request a side session passed on from you, to stop saving blank projects without a good reason. It's uncommitted in the main checkout.

## Why the blank project can't go
- **OrcaSlicer needs it:** `Plater` holds its model directly as `Slic3r::Model model`, `Plater.cpp` calls `model()` 97 times, and upstream creates a new project at startup.
- **JusPrin needs it too:** 22 fork files reach the live model or plater, including about 150 uses in `OrcaWorkspaceAdapter.cpp`. The canvas also starts by selecting the Prepare tab.
- **What it would take:** having no project means changing OrcaSlicer-owned code throughout, and every rebase would have to carry that. Nothing a person sees would improve over keeping it in memory.

## What changed
Autosave used to save a blank project as soon as its document changed at all. I reproduced that in a scratch copy of the real app, then reran the same steps after the fix:

| Action on a blank project | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Launch | 0 folders | 0 |
| Printer switch | 1 saved project | 0 (the choice stays in the app's settings) |
| Read-only tool (`workspace_inspect`) | 1 saved project | 0 |

The harness also shows no save for these, though they were saved before:
- choosing a chat model
- making or checkpointing an empty chat
- typing a draft and clearing it
- replacing the blank project with a new one

## Saves I kept, for you to overrule
- **Your own content:** a chat message, a typed draft, an attachment, a print record or a calibration.
- **A setting edit on an empty plate:** the edit isn't stored anywhere else, so I'd expect it to be lost otherwise. I read this in the code but didn't test the loss.
- **The version saved before an agent action changes the project:** this is what the action can go back to. If the action fails, a folder stays on disk with no Home card.

## Side effects
- **Existing blank cards:** they disappear from Home, but their folders stay on disk.
- **Empty chats:** a chat model picked on a blank project is forgotten when that project is replaced. An older empty chat has nothing to resume, so it shows as unavailable.
- **OrcaSlicer's temp files:** it still creates a temporary folder for each run, with a lock file and a config file. That isn't a saved project, so I left it.

## Test results
- **Passing:** `agent_bridge_tests` (492 cases), the new `--blank-project-saves` mode (80 checks), and the default, reopen, chat restoration, file opening, external history and task chat modes.
- **Failing, probably not from this change:** I read both in the code but have no run from before the fix. I put the fix in a task card you can start.
  - `--autosave-seed` has one stale check that expects a "Saved" status, which Home stopped producing on 2026-10-26.
  - `--print-history` crashes on a null menu pointer in the harness's own helper.
- **Not tested:**
  - Clicking the printer chip by hand. The real-app run switched printers through the `printer_setup` tool, and the harness only simulates the chip's recorded change.
  - Windows and Linux builds.
  - The first-run Benchy example and its `fresh_example_leaves_no_blank_project` check, which exist only in the credits worktree.

## Overlap with the credits work
The uncommitted `authored_head` edit in the `credits-onboarding` worktree touches the same function and will conflict. It only hid the blank card and is no longer needed, so it can be dropped once this lands.

The button's intended text was to propose how JusPrin can start on Home without a blank project behind it, including what depends on that project today.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - OrcaSlicer's `Plater::priv` holds `Slic3r::Model model` as a value member. Upstream startup calls `trigger_restore_project(1)`, then `new_project` in the `EVT_RESTORE_PROJECT` handler.
   - JusPrin keeps that Plater. `ProjectPersistence::attach` and `ProjectAutosave::adopt_project` give the empty project an identity. `ProjectVersionStore` creates a project's folder on first write (6165ea6aee).
   - Home lists a project only if `authored_head` is true (objects in the manifest, or a document holding work).
   - Agent tools that change the project call `pin_current` for a before-version (`changes_printable_project`, `m_version_before`, `m_version_after`).
   - Chat checkpoints go through `AgentHost::checkpoint_active_chat`.
   - Project rules: fork-owned files only where possible; commit only when asked; temp docs stay untracked; shared-machine build rules (`-j4`, one build per directory, setpgrp); reproduce before fixing; no attribution lines in commits.

3. Files and Code Sections (all uncommitted in the main checkout `/Users/kenneth/Projects/JusPrin`, branch `jusprin-newui`; none is OrcaSlicer-owned):
   - `src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Workspace/ProjectAutosave.cpp`: added `holds_work`, and `authored_head` now uses it. `tick()` and `save_now()` replaced their `objects.empty && head empty && doc_revision<=1` test with `blank_with_no_work()`.
     ```cpp
     bool holds_work(const nlohmann::json& state)
     {
         const auto recorded = [&state](const char* key) { return !state.value(key, nlohmann::json::array()).empty(); };
         const auto changes  = state.value("changes", nlohmann::json::array());
         const auto chats    = state.value("conversations", nlohmann::json::array());
         return recorded("attachments") || recorded("gcodes") || recorded("regions") || state.contains("calibration") ||
                !state.value("draft", "").empty() ||
                std::any_of(changes.begin(), changes.end(), [](const nlohmann::json& change) { return change.value("kind", "") != "preset"; }) ||
                std::any_of(chats.begin(), chats.end(), [](const nlohmann::json& chat) { return !chat.value("messages", nlohmann::json::array()).empty(); });
     }
     bool ProjectAutosave::blank_with_no_work()
     {
         adopt_project();
         return m_plater.model().objects.empty() && m_store->head_id().empty() &&
                !holds_work(nlohmann::json::parse(m_persistence.document().dump()));
     }
     ```

   - `Shell/ShellController.cpp`: passes `[this] { return m_autosave->blank_with_no_work(); }` to the chat callbacks and `[this] { return m_autosave && m_autosave->blank_with_no_work(); }` to the version callbacks.
   - `tests/shell/shell_harness.cpp`: new mode `--blank-project-saves` (`Mode::BlankProjectSaves`, `verify_blank_project_saves`, `check_blank_stays_unsaved`, `project_folders`, `project_folder_names`).

   - `agent-docs/jusprin/autosave-version-history.md`: new paragraph stating the rule for the empty project.
   - Memory: `blank-project-behind-home-inherited.md` (updated), with a pointer in `MEMORY.md`.

   - `entire search` failed because the repository isn't mirrored to Entire, and the checkpoint IDs don't resolve. I used local transcripts instead.
   - `real_check.py` first failed because `probe.call` needs a `urlsplit` result, and the conf file is `JusPrin2.conf`. The printer preset name is `MyMarlin 0.4 nozzle`. All fixed.
   - After the first fix the real app still saved, because `printer_setup` pinned a before-version. Fixed with `switches_printer_on_blank`.

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Reproduced before the fix, in the real app on scratch data:** `workspace_inspect` alone gave 1 folder with HEAD. A real printer switch gave 1 folder with HEAD and changes `['preset','preset']`. The harness new mode had 18 failures.
   - **After the fix, in the real app:** 0 folders after a printer switch and after read-only tools, and no `projects` folder at all. The conf has `presets.machine` = `MyMarlin 0.4 nozzle`, so the choice survives.
   - **Test results:**
     - `agent_bridge_tests`: all passed (19788 assertions, 492 cases)
     - `--blank-project-saves`: 80 pass
     - default: 599 pass
     - `--autosave-reopen`: 55 pass
     - `--chat-restoration`: 74 pass
     - `--file-opening`: 71 pass
     - `--external-project-history`: 77 pass
     - `--task-chat`: 91 pass
   - **Two remaining faults, each repeated when run alone:**
     - `--autosave-seed`: 68 pass, 1 fail, `home_describes_managed_project`. The check expects status "Saved" (added by 48c402949b, 2026-10-24), but since dbec3e3a38 (2026-10-26) Home only produces Draft, Sent, Printed or Printing.
     - `--print-history`: 96 pass, then exit 139 inside the harness helper `print_history_preferences_routes` on a null `wxMenu` (from ebbb2f8894).
     - Both look older than my change from reading the code; I have no pre-change run. I proposed session card `task_e5167e05`, "Fix two broken shell harness suites".
   - **Why removing the blank project isn't practical:**
     - `Slic3r::Model model` is a value member (`Plater.cpp:4351`), and `Plater.cpp` has 97 `model()` uses.
     - 22 fork files reach the live model or plater (`OrcaWorkspaceAdapter.cpp` 150 uses, `ProjectAutosave.cpp` 35, `OrcaOutline.cpp` 33, `ShellController.cpp` 27, `GcodeHistoryRecorder.cpp` 25, `PrintIssueMonitor.cpp` 23).
     - `post_init` selects the Prepare tab to map the GL canvas before OpenGL starts.
     - `adopt_project` throws if there is no identity.
     - Upstream `new_project` runs at startup, and every line changed in an OrcaSlicer-owned file must be re-resolved at each rebase.
     - Recommendation: keep the in-memory empty project, which is what this fix does.
   - **OrcaSlicer temp folder:** each run makes a folder under `$TMPDIR/orcaslicer_model/<date>/<time#pid#...>` holding `lock.txt` and `_temp_1.config`. It is upstream behaviour, is not a saved project, and I left it alone.
   - **Saves kept on purpose:**
     - chat messages, typed drafts, attachments, print records, calibration
     - a setting edit on an empty plate (my expectation is it would otherwise be lost; I read this rather than tested the loss)
     - the before-version for agent actions that change the project, other than printer switches; a failed action leaves a folder with no Home card
   - **Side effects:**
     - Existing blank cards are hidden from Home, not deleted; their folders stay on disk.
     - A chat model picked on an untouched blank project isn't kept once that project is replaced.
     - An empty chat left behind on a blank project has no checkpoint, so viewing it later shows resume as unavailable.

     - clicking the printer chip in the UI (the real switch went through the `printer_setup` tool, which records the same preset changes; the harness fakes that entry)

**A project now saves only when it holds a model or was already saved, as you decided; chats no longer count.** This replaces my earlier version of the fix. It passes on macOS except for two test faults that were already failing before this rewrite, and it's uncommitted in the main checkout.

No OrcaSlicer-owned file changed. App code grew because the first import now runs with no saved version to go back to, and leaving an unsaved project now cleans up its folder. The list of what counted as work and the printer and empty-chat special cases are gone.

## What you'll see
- **Nothing on an empty plate saves:** a chat, draft, setting edit, printer choice or tool call leaves no project behind. All of that is lost on restart or when a file is opened, including setting edits.
- **The first model saves everything so far:** the project is saved along with its chats and attachments up to that point.
- **Undoing the agent's first import:** this now means deleting the object, because there's no saved empty version to go back to.
- **A project emptied later:** it keeps saving and keeps its Home card, so its earlier versions stay reachable.
- **Older projects that never held a model:** this includes chat-only ones. They lose their Home card but stay on disk.

## Decisions I made
- **Attachments on an empty plate:** they're still written to the project's folder straight away, because a model attachment needs a real file path. The folder is removed when you leave the project or quit, and it survives a switch to classic view. After a crash it can stay behind, with no Home card.
- **Directly opened G-code:** this can't lose a print record through the agent. It has no objects, but in the real app `export_file` and `print_dialog_open` both refuse with "slice first". From reading the code, the export menu needs objects and OrcaSlicer disables printing after opening G-code; I didn't click those in the UI.

## For you to decide
The header still says "Saved" on an empty plate that has a chat, even though that chat will be lost. I didn't change it, since nobody has decided whether the app should say so. A related gap: a chat left on an empty plate before a model is added has no version to resume from, so resuming it says "This chat has no recoverable project checkpoint."

## Test results

- **Not tested:**
  - a real model conversation on an empty plate; the harness adds the chat message directly, and no model was called
  - clicking the printer chip by hand
  - Windows and Linux builds
  - the first-run Benchy example in the credits worktree
